Name: The Neighborly Collection - Tractor Garage
Author: redundantghost
Description:
[left][size=4][font=Arial][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29080]The Neighborly Collection[/url] is a gorgeous farm building replacement but unfortunately doesn't have a matching garage for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Tractor Mod[/url]. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/cajcbell]cajcbell[/url] kindly granted me permission to use the existing art so I threw together a seasonal replacement.[/font][/size][/left]

[size=4][font=Arial]This doesn't change the tractor itself - [b]just the garage![/b] It is also does not have paint masks, like the original Neighborly Collection. I don't use Alternative Textures so I have no plans to make an AT version.[/font][/size]

[size=4][font=Arial]Install like any other Content Patcher mod by unzipping into your Mods folder.[/font][/size]

[size=4][font=Arial][b]Credits[/b][/font][/size]

[size=4][font=Arial][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/cajcbell]cajcbell[/url] - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29080]The Neighborly Collection[/url][/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Arial][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Pathoschild]Pathoschild[/url] - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Tractor Mod[/url][/font][/size]
